summary: Frontend-only regression + verification for Storia nav route and menu translations. All 4 verification points passed: (A) desktop and mobile 'Storia' links navigate to /storia route (react-router) and render data-testid='story-page'; (B) menu section titles translate correctly across IT/EN/DE/FR on cucina/pizza/vini tabs (Antipasti→Starters/Vorspeisen/Entrées; Le Speciali→The Specials/Die Spezialitäten/Les Spéciales; Vini Rossi→Red Wines/Rotweine/Vins Rouges; Primi Piatti→First Courses/Erste Gänge/Entrées de pâtes; Secondi Piatti→Main Courses/Hauptgänge/Plats principaux); (C) pizza 'Rustica' description translates while name stays Italian - IT 'Pomodoro, mozzarella, pancetta e cipolle' → EN 'Tomato, mozzarella, pancetta and onions', DE 'Tomate, mozzarella, pancetta und Zwiebeln', FR 'Tomate, mozzarella, pancetta et oignons' (no leftover ' e ' connector); (D) menu tab switching still works and reservation form structure intact (reservation-form, res-name, res-guests, area-interno/esterno, res-date, res-time, reservation-submit).
critical_code_review_comments: MenuSection uses AnimatePresence mode='wait' with 0.5s exit+enter; automated tests need ~1s+ waits after tab switch to observe new content (informational only, not a bug).

translateDesc capitalises the first char only ('Tomate, mozzarella, ...'). 'mozzarella' and 'pancetta' remain lowercase in translated output - visually acceptable as they are proper Italian ingredient nouns but inconsistent with common sentence-case rules. Not blocking.
In DE output 'und' appears lowercase mid-sentence which is grammatically correct; no issue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Menu tab clicks require ~1200ms wait due to framer-motion AnimatePresence mode='wait' (0.5s exit + 0.5s enter). h4 for menu items with star attr contains a nested *, so use childNodes[0].textContent for exact name match. Language switcher: click data-testid='language-switcher-button' then 'lang-option-{it|en|de|fr}'. Story route confirmed working desktop+mobile via react-router Link. Reservation form testids all present but a live POST /api/reservations submission was NOT executed in this iteration (previous iterations already validated). Static preloader bypass with ?static=1 works.
